I will farm this maize the way I can manage with the cash and labor I have, not by guessing. Last season I used fertilizer on the better parts and it paid, so this season I will use improved seed again and put chemical fertilizer, but not too heavily because 3.52 hectares is a big area to finance at once. I own this land, so I do not mind investing in it, and because the plot is bigger than what my family can finish alone at planting and weeding, I will hire some labor and use herbicide, but I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains here in Arusha.
